display_name: 源域逐时滞严格中心化统计对比
description: 对比全窗中心化近似与逐滞后子段分别中心化的二二共轭四阶统计，仅进行源记录配对检索。
authorization: User authorizes ongoing Phase1 F-free restoration research, source-only diagnostics and GPU use.

code.environment: N607 CPU two threads deterministic FP32, GPU disabled

data.dataset: Phase1 Main split permitted source L_s/U_s
data.representation: fixed source DURA context and paired IQ; 512 fit IDs for normalization, disjoint 512 for retrieval
data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: First 512 ordered fit IDs normalize fixed source features; next 512 ordered fit IDs evaluated across three simulated source views
data.validation_ref: Disjoint 512 source fit IDs for normalization and 512 for physical-record retrieval; all are training-pool source IDs

permissions.claim_scope: Source physical-record retrieval only with privileged clean IQ; no TX identity, deployable lookup or target claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen original DURA v1.0 and deterministic source context; no trained recovery candidate
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Original DURA provenance and exact ordered 32768 source fit IDs; no F/TX/V/target
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: DURA and source context F/TX/V/target-free source only
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed two centering formulas and equal block weighting; no target or model selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two threads, nice15; preserve ongoing GPU training and other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on invalid source contract, nonfinite features, incompatible view alignment or technical failure; preserve artifacts

expected_artifacts: result.json: source record top1/top5/MRR/distance for both centering methods and combinations

dimensions: 512 normalization plus 512 other source physical IDs x three simulated views
power, window-centering, slice-centering and two combinations
metrics_plan.scorer_ref: none; no target or TX truth

rows.method: Per-lag separately centered vs window-centered 2+2 conjugate fourth-order moment differences, 32-band power and equal-block combinations
rows.purpose: Source same-record feature geometry only; not transmitter identity
rows.seed_notes: Fixed existing source ID order and views; no new random sampling or trained model.
rows.scenario: 512 held-out-from-normalization source fit IDs, three legal simulated source views
rows.budget_ref: 512 normalization IDs and 512 disjoint retrieval IDs; three existing views, no training
expected_artifacts: result.json: source record top1/top5/MRR/distance for both centering methods and combinations

notes: Fixed legal source training pool only; DURA may have seen these records.
Clean-source record matching may reflect waveform content, not TX identity, and is unavailable as a target reference library.
No F, TX, V or target reads; no model updates and no changes to ongoing training or formal tests.
